plugins.name: NPC schedule editor
plugins.desc: Author NPC schedules with time, activity, and location nodes. Add condition branches and export schedule JSON. The sample shows how the graph can support tasks beyond dialogue.

plugins.name: AI assistant (DeepSeek)
plugins.desc: Polish character voices, continue dialogue, suggest options, and check consistency. Requires your own API key. Core editing and export work without AI.

_note: Plugin manifest. Set enabled to false to disable a plugin. Register entry paths relative to plugins/. Names and descriptions appear in the plugin manager.
